# Functional Enrichment Analysis {#enrichment}

`sclet` provides `RunEnrichment` to seamlessly perform GO/KEGG enrichment analysis on marker genes.

## Load data and find markers

```{r}
library(sclet)
sce <- readRDS("data/pancreas_sub_sce.rds")
# Find markers for all clusters
markers <- FindAllMarkers(sce, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
head(markers)
```

## GO Enrichment

```{r go_enrich, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Ensure you have org.Mm.eg.db installed for Mouse data
# or org.Hs.eg.db for Human
library(org.Mm.eg.db) 

go_res <- RunEnrichment(
    markers, 
    db = "GO", 
    orgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", 
    keyType = "SYMBOL", 
    ont = "BP"
)

library(enrichplot)
dotplot(go_res, showCategory=5)
```

## KEGG Enrichment

For KEGG, it is recommended to convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs first, or provide a column with Entrez IDs if available.

